text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein sends letters to European Union leaders relating to Jordanian-European ties; cabinet reviews the latest developments after the Jerusalem bombing.
- Crown Prince urges resumption of Israeli-Palestinian peace talks to avoid further bloodshed; intensive Jordanian diplomacy to ease the plight of the Palestinian people.
- Deputy Prime Minister Abdullah Ensour says there is no connection between the militant Islamic Hamas movement's leadership resident in Jordan and the Jerusalem suicide bombing.
- Jordan intensifies efforts with the United States and Israel to dilute crisis.
